name: playwright-openapi-api-automation
description: Learning project for generating an API and Playwright API tests from an OpenAPI 3.0 specification.

scripts.generate: npm run generate:api && npm run generate:tests && npm run generate:edge-tests
scripts.test:contract: npm run generate:tests && npm run generate:edge-tests && playwright test tests/generated
scripts.test:edge: npm run generate:edge-tests && playwright test tests/generated/openapi.edge.spec.ts
